2607.18927.title: OntoBook: Ontology-Grounded Synthetic Textbooks for Medical Encoder Pretraining
2607.18927.paper_summary: We present OntoBook, a method that converts medical ontology structure into pretraining signal for encoder language models. Our approach has three stages: random walks through ontology graphs capture hierarchical and causal relations between medical codes, a large language model reformulates these walks into fluent textbook-style prose, and the resulting text is used to train ModernCamemBERT, a 149M-parameter French encoder, with two objectives on the same data: masked language modeling and relation prediction between code pairs. On three French medical coding benchmarks (FRACCO, Cantemist-FR, Distemist-FR), OntoBook achieves significant improvements over MLM-only pretraining, with +2.5 micro-F1 on FRACCO and +8.0 micro-F1 on Distemist. We find that alignment between objectives is necessary: misaligned training, where each task uses different data, causes a 30-point degradation. We release 1.3 million LLM-reformulated medical textbooks across three French ontologies (CIM-10, CCAM, ATC) and pretrained model checkpoints.
2607.18927.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了OntoBook，一種將醫學本體結構轉換為編碼器語言模型預訓練信號的方法。<lb/>我們的方法分為三個階段：隨機漫遊本體圖捕捉醫學代碼之間的層級和因果關係，<lb/>大型語言模型將這些漫遊重新表述為流暢的教科書風格的散文，<lb/>生成的文本用於訓練ModernCamemBERT，一個具有1.49億參數的法語編碼器，<lb/>在同一數據上有兩個目標：掩蔽語言建模和代碼對之間的關係預測。<lb/>在三個法語醫學編碼基準（FRACCO、Cantemist-FR、Distemist-FR）上，OntoBook在僅進行MLM預訓練的基礎上取得了顯著的改進，<lb/>在FRACCO上提高了2.5的微F1，在Distemist上提高了8.0的微F1。<lb/>我們發現目標之間的對齊是必要的：不對齊的訓練，其中每個任務使用不同的數據，會導致30點的降級。<lb/>我們釋放了130萬本經過LLM重新表述的醫學教科書，涵蓋三個法語本體（CIM-10、CCAM、ATC）和預訓練模型檢查點。
